profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Great American
profile.summary:
At Great American Insurance Group, our team embraces agile methodologies to propel software development to new heights. With a focus on continuous improvement, we've maintained high standards through test-driven development and meticulous code reviews. A recent proof of concept project I led exemplified our commitment to quality and stakeholder alignment.

My educational journey at Tech Elevator culminated in mastering Java Web Application Development, fortifying my technical acumen. Leveraging tools like Figma and Git, I contribute to a culture of collaboration and innovation. Our synergy across multiple teams underscores the shared success we achieve in delivering impactful technological solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As an Agile Developer I play a crucial role in driving software excellence and innovation. Here’s a glimpse of my journey:

Adherence to Excellence: Maintained rigorous standards in software development, including test-driven development, comprehensive code reviews, version control, and promoting code readability to ensure top-notch quality.

Proof of Concept Leadership: Key contributor in a proof of concept project, ensuring alignment with stakeholders and external teams to deliver impactful results.

Collaborative Synergy: Worked seamlessly with over 10 teams across 6 business units, fostering a culture of collaboration and shared success.

Agile Mastery: Applied agile principles to meet the dynamic and ever-evolving needs of the business, delivering solutions that exceeded expectations.

Continuous Learning: Embraced new skills across 4 different projects, showcasing adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement in response to evolving challenges.

Innovative Implementation: Implemented patches and introduced new functionalities across 7 unique applications, enhancing the user experience and driving business growth.
positions.insights: Back-End Web Development, Front-End Development and +18 skills

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Currently enrolled as a Java bootcamp student at Tech Elevator.  Below is a list of projects I’ve completed during my time here:

Vending Machine Application
Displays products available. Options to add money to the machine, select products for purchase, and return the appropriate amount of change. The application also has two backlogs one that keeps track of every transaction that takes place and another that logs total sales. Skills used: Object - Oriented programming, Java, while loops, conditional statements, collections like Maps and Lists, command-Line programming, inheritance as well as Polymorphism. 

Tenmo Server
Built a secure money transfer API similar to Venmo, using MVC pattern and REST. Server-side is powered by Spring framework and incorporates PostgreSQL. Security uses JSON Web Tokens(JWTs) fir authentication and authorization.
positions.insights: Back-End Web Development, HTML and +12 skills

positions.title: Account Coordinator
positions.description:
Customer Engagement: Personally attended to customers daily, handling quote requests, product shipment updates, quality assurance, and providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs.

Product Research: Dedicated several hours to researching fiber optic cabling, focusing on product standardization, construction, and industry applications to enhance product knowledge and support customer inquiries effectively.

Shipment Management: Managed all incoming and outgoing shipments, including product inspection, packaging, labeling, and tracking to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
